method.advance: In the notice panel, add useful locations in at least two distinct works across both generator families, with at most one additional ordinary source group. Keep every useful current location. The article packet measures specificity only.
method.baseline: First six source-ordered positive native contexts. Compare both individual cards and their union.
method.comparison: Six Federal Register groups with whole-paragraph known edits. Separately replay ten Kubernetes groups to measure ordinary flags and single-sentence spill. The two packets are disjoint and were previously measured for other rules. No fitting or inference.
method.labels: A shared range records the intersection of two contexts. Neither response directly measures the shared range alone.
method.paragraph: For notices also require the retained whole-paragraph response at the same fixed point.
method.shared: Two adjacent complete three-sentence windows with distinct outside sentences and two shared middle sentences. All four sentences must be in one interior paragraph. Rank by the smaller raw response, abstain on a tie, and propose only the shared pair.
method.useful: At least 0.30 non-whitespace character intersection over union and 0.50 recall.
